mapper.select: SELECT ddpvuc.id, t.dates, t.pkg, t.`user_type`, t.`version`, t.user_source, t.user_num, t.extra_type source_type FROM (select duc.dates, duc.pkg, 0 `user_type`, duc.version `version`, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknown') user_source, count(DISTINCT duc.user_id) user_num, duc.extra_type from dwd_user_conversion duc left join dim_user_source dus on (dus.user_id = duc.user_id) where duc.dates = #{dates} group by duc.dates, duc.pkg, duc.version, duc.extra_type, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknown')) t left join dws_daily_pkg_ver_usrc_conversion ddpvuc on (t.dates = ddpvuc.dates and t.pkg = ddpvuc.pkg and t.user_type = ddpvuc.user_type and t.version = ddpvuc.version and t.user_source = ddpvuc.user_source and t.extra_type = ddpvuc.source_type)

SELECT ddpvuc.id, t.dates, t.pkg, t.`user_type`, t.`version`, t.user_source, t.user_num, t.extra_type source_type FROM (select duc.dates, duc.pkg, 1 `user_type`, duc.version `version`, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknown') user_source, count(DISTINCT duc.user_id) user_num, duc.extra_type from dwd_user_conversion duc left join dim_user_source dus on (dus.user_id = duc.user_id) where duc.dates = #{dates} and duc.dates = duc.register_dates group by duc.dates, duc.pkg, duc.version, duc.extra_type, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknown')) t left join dws_daily_pkg_ver_usrc_conversion ddpvuc on (t.dates = ddpvuc.dates and t.pkg = ddpvuc.pkg and t.user_type = ddpvuc.user_type and t.version = ddpvuc.version and t.user_source = ddpvuc.user_source and t.extra_type = ddpvuc.source_type)
select id, dates, pkg, version, user_source, user_type, user_num, source_type from dws_daily_pkg_ver_usrc_conversion where dates = #{dates}
